messages:
liz: quick sync — NewMarket (enterprise) wants a POC. Key asks: SSO (SAML) both IdP/SP flows, SCIM group provisioning (delta preferred), domain locking (verify ownership of newmarket.com and subdomains), per-team RBAC mapping (SCIM groups -> roles), audit log stream to customer SIEM, and dedicated capacity pricing. Also asked about SCIM rate limits and SCIM full vs delta window. Any blockers for us to run a clean POC?

oliver-se: we can support this. SAML: both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated are supported. We accept standard attributes (email/name/groups) and persistent NameID. For RBAC you can either map SAML group claims to roles or use SCIM group->role mapping. No blocker there.

oliver-se: sample SAML attribute mapping we typically ask for:```
AttributeName: urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3 -> user.email
AttributeName: groups -> user.groups
NameID Format: persistent
```

kelly-ps: POC plan (high level): 1) provision trial tenant + ephemeral Dedicated pool (2 GPUs) 2) exchange SAML metadata (we provide SP metadata) 3) configure SCIM token + map 2-3 groups to roles 4) enable audit log forwarding (syslog/HTTP) 5) smoke test login + group sync. Estimate 8-10 business days assuming IdP access and DNS TXT for domain proofing.

samir: ballpark on pricing: Dedicated starter commit for this scale is $18k/month (2x A100-style GPU equivalent). If they need sustained higher throughput we can size up; also offer monthly vs annual commit. For pricing accuracy I need expected qps/session length and token volume. Can someone confirm expected concurrency?

liz: they indicated ~50k MAU, peak 200 concurrent inference sessions, short chat context (~256 tokens). Is that sufficient for a sizing calc?

oliver-se: that helps. For chat with 256 tokens and that concurrency we'd recommend 2-4 cards (GPUs) for predictable latency at 99th pct. I'll add more precise numbers in the follow-up sizing doc. Also note: SCIM churn matters — if they have heavy group churn (many adds/removes per minute) we tune delta window and reduce full-sync frequency.

tina: security checklist/questions: do we provide SOC 2 Type II report and penetration test summary? Is data encrypted at rest with customer-managed KMS? Can audit logs be exported to the customer's SIEM (syslog/HTTPS) with < 1 min latency? What is our retention policy for provisioning events (they asked 13 months)? Also need to confirm data residency (EU vs US).

liz: @tina we need to answer that before legal signs off. Audit logs -> they want SIEM ingestion into Splunk.

audit-bot: security-questionnaire.pdf uploaded to thread (link: https://redwood.internal/qna/2791239876).

tina: ok thanks. Short answers: SOC2 Type II — yes (pdf will be attached), pen-test summary — redacted non-prod details (we'll share summary), KMS: hosted default + option for customer-managed KMS for Private deployments, audit log export — yes via secure HTTPS endpoint or syslog with token auth, retention — configurable, default 12 months but can extend to 24 months on enterprise plan (we'll confirm 13 months specifically). Data residency — supported by Private deployment or region-specific Dedicated (we can host in eu-west for EU data). I'll draft formal responses.

kelly-ps: SCIM details: we support SCIM 2.0 with PATCH, delta sync (lastUpdated filter) and incremental change tokens. Rate limits: default 600 reqs/min for hosted, can increase for Dedicated. Full-sync fallback supported but we recommend delta for production. Example SCIM mapping snippet we send customers:```
{
  "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"],
  "userName": "{{user.email}}",
  "name": {"givenName": "{{user.firstName}}", "familyName": "{{user.lastName}}"},
  "groups": ["engineering","support"]
}
```

liz: perfect. Also need domain-proofing steps for their security/compliance — they want to lock to newmarket.com and allow only certain subdomains. What's the DNS flow?

oliver-se: we require a TXT record under `_redwood-verify.newmarket.com` with a token we provide. For wildcard subdomain enforcement we also verify the apex and add an org-level policy. This must be done before issuing custom domain certs. No sensitive data is placed in TXT beyond the token.

samir: next commercial question: do we offer trial credits for Dedicated POC or is a short paid pilot required?

kelly-ps: we typically provide a timeboxed pilot: 2-week dedicated pool with reduced pilot pricing (50% off) or trial credits on hosted if customer is flexible (but hosted doesn't isolate data). For enterprise legal we usually need an MSA/DSA in place.

liz: next steps agreed: (1) oliver to post sizing doc + SAML attribute template (by EOD) (2) tina to draft security questionnaire answers and attach SOC2 + pen-test summary (tomorrow) (3) samir to send a pilot commercial term email with pricing options (today) (4) kelly to prep POC runbook + SCIM mapping example + dns proofing token.

oliver-se: I'll drop the sizing calc and a minimal SAML metadata sample here in ~3 hours.

samir: I'll ping procurement and get expected concurrency confirmation and budget.

liz: thanks all — I'll set up a 30m call with NewMarket for Monday and include IdP admin. :thumbsup:
